mapper.select: SELECT id, package_name, package_content FROM byai.tenant_package_spec WHERE id = #{packageId} AND enabled = TRUE
SELECT id, package_name, package_content FROM byai.tenant_package_spec WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT e.enterprise_id, e.com_acct_name AS enterprise_name, n.params_value AS package_name, s.params_value AS provision_state_json, to_char(r.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, CASE WHEN s.params_value::jsonb ->> 'status' = 'READY' THEN to_char(s.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END AS opened_at, f.params_value AS failure_reason, m.user_id AS created_by FROM byai.tenant_config r JOIN byai.po_enterprise_info e ON e.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id LEFT JOIN byai.tenant_user_membership m ON m.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND m.role = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN byai.tenant_config n ON n.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND n.params_code = 'PACKAGE_NAME_SNAPSHOT' LEFT JOIN byai.tenant_config s ON s.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND s.params_code = 'PROVISION_STATE' LEFT JOIN byai.tenant_config f ON f.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND f.params_code = 'PROVISION_FAILURE_REASON' WHERE r.params_code = 'PROVISION_REQUEST_ID' AND r.params_value = #{requestId}

SELECT e.enterprise_id, e.com_acct_name AS enterprise_name, n.params_value AS package_name, s.params_value AS provision_state_json, to_char(r.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, CASE WHEN s.params_value::jsonb ->> 'status' = 'READY' THEN to_char(s.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END AS opened_at, f.params_value AS failure_reason, m.user_id AS created_by FROM byai.po_enterprise_info e JOIN byai.tenant_config r ON r.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND r.params_code = 'PROVISION_REQUEST_ID' LEFT JOIN byai.tenant_config n ON n.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND n.params_code = 'PACKAGE_NAME_SNAPSHOT' LEFT JOIN byai.tenant_config s ON s.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND s.params_code = 'PROVISION_STATE' LEFT JOIN byai.tenant_config f ON f.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND f.params_code = 'PROVISION_FAILURE_REASON' LEFT JOIN byai.tenant_user_membership m ON m.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND m.role = 'OWNER'
AND (s.params_value IS NULL OR s.params_value::jsonb ->> 'status' != 'DELETED')
AND LOWER(e.com_acct_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{name}) || '%'
AND r.created_at >= #{createdFrom}
AND r.created_at < #{createdTo}
ORDER BY
e.com_acct_name CASE WHEN s.params_value::jsonb ->> 'status' = 'READY' THEN s.updated_at END r.created_at
ASC DESC , e.enterprise_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO byai.po_enterprise_info (enterprise_id, com_acct_name, com_acct_code, system_name) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{name}, 'tenant-' || #{enterpriseId}, #{name})
INSERT INTO byai.tenant_config (id, enterprise_id, params_code, params_value) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{code}, #{value})
INSERT INTO byai.tenant_user_membership (membership_id, enterprise_id, user_id, role, status, created_by) VALUES (#{membershipId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{userId}, 'OWNER', 'ACTIVE', #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT params_value FROM byai.tenant_config WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND params_code = #{code}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM byai.tenant_config WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND params_code = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT params_code AS "paramsCode", params_value AS "paramsValue" FROM byai.tenant_config WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}
SELECT e.com_acct_name FROM byai.po_enterprise_info e JOIN byai.tenant_config r ON r.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND r.params_code = 'PROVISION_REQUEST_ID' WHERE e.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}
SELECT enterprise_id FROM byai.tenant_config WHERE params_code = 'TENANT_DELETE_REQUESTED' AND params_value = 'true' ORDER BY enterprise_id LIMIT 100
